build_arrow_dataset: build a dataset from Arrow IPC stream or file format using the Arrow builder
create_arrow_config: create an ArrowConfig with optional Features to configure the Arrow dataset builder
generate_arrow_tables: generate PyArrow tables from Arrow IPC files by reading record batches and casting to schema
infer_arrow_features: infer dataset features from the Arrow schema stored in an IPC file
cast_arrow_table: cast a PyArrow table to match a target Arrow schema for nested features
